note: Large collection whose own description reads "all of the workflows of n8n i could find (also from the site itself)" -- collected, not authored. Held redistributable until 2026-08-25 on a measured 0.0% overlap with the official library; that figure is an artifact. The overlap test matches on structuralHash, which keeps only edges whose endpoints resolve, and 99.5% of this corpus has connections naming nodes that do not exist -- so it hashes on node types alone and cannot match a clean official template. Comparing on node types instead found 490 exact matches, 208 on workflows too large for coincidence. Link-only per the rule already applied to zengfr and ScraperNode: a LICENSE file cannot cover work the uploader did not author. See docs/audit/2026-08-25/01-CORPUS-INTEGRITY.md.

Near-complete mirror of the official n8n library: 98.0% of its 10,116 files also exist on n8n.io (measure/mirror-overlap.ts, run rederive-64), and its README describes the repo as synchronized every 2 months. The Apache-2.0 file cannot license work the uploader did not author, so matching workflows are demoted to link_only per entry by rights/official-mirror.ts. Kept as a source: the entries are still worth cataloguing and deep-linking.
Mirror of the official n8n library: 99.3% of its 8,697 files also exist on n8n.io (rederive-64). Reports MIT; matching workflows are demoted to link_only per entry, same reason as zengfr.

Excluded on 2026-09-03 after the configured GitHub repository returned HTTP 404 / Repository not found for both HEAD and main. Do not reacquire or publish its former entries until an owner supplies a verified replacement source and rights evidence.
